newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRA shares trail RTZ higher.
newsitem.headline: CRA shares trail RTZ higher.

text.p: Shares in miner CRA Ltd underpinned the record breaking Australian share market on Monday, its shares jumping 2.5 percent to an intraday high of A$19.05 after its sister dual listed entity, RTZ Plc, leapt 2.3 percent in London on Friday.
Broker said the RTZ Plc's rise was fuelled by broker upgrades, notably by London broker UBS Drew Phillips on Thursday, which upgraded the multi-metal miner to hold from sell.
Since the close on February 6, CRA shares have climbed 4.4 percent to today's high, slightly outperforming the rise in RTZ Plc of four percent over the same period.

"RTZ had been subject to a number of downgrades over the last month in the U.K. and maybe Thursday's move by UBS flagged a cessation of that," said a senior dealer at a Sydney brokerage, adding that CRA's performance had been similarly affected by its sibling's moves.
"To that extent, CRA has certainly been a major underperformer in this market and was probably due for a bit of a rebound."
By 1.20 p.m. (0220 GMT), CRA shares had eased from early highs with the broader market to be 30 cents higher at A$18.88 on turnover of 584,412 shares.
